nodes.summary: Nx workspace configuration defining named inputs, plugins, target defaults, generator defaults, and cloud connectivity settings for the monorepo.

nodes.name: opencode.json

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Workspace root manifest declaring npm scripts, dependencies, devDependencies, workspaces, and Nx settings for the appelli_db monorepo.

nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration that extends the base config and wires up project references for incremental builds across the workspace.
